ValidationRule.description: National Id must look like NNN-NN-NNNN, not start with 000, 666 or 9, and its 3 groups may not be all-zero or reversed duplicates.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(National_Id__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(National_Id__c, '[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}')), IF(REGEX(National_Id__c, '[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}'), OR( LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = '000', LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = '666', VALUE(LEFT(National_Id__c, 1)) = 9, MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2) = '00', RIGHT(National_Id__c, 4) = '0000', LEFT(National_Id__c, 3) = REVERSE(LEFT(National_Id__c, 3)) && MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2) = REVERSE(MID(National_Id__c, 5, 2)) ), FALSE) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: National Id has an invalid format or an impossible group.
